Darab Khan

  • Email: kdarab13@gmail.com
  • Phone: +1 4313236520
  • Address: Winnipeg, MB

Professional Summary

Motivated and detail-oriented final-year Advanced Economics student with a minor in Computer Science at the University of Manitoba, actively pursuing the CFA Level 1 designation. Possess a solid foundation in financial principles and a strong commitment to professional growth. Experienced in data analysis, financial modeling, and applying quantitative methods to solve complex problems. Eager to leverage analytical skills, attention to detail, and a passion for finance in a dynamic role as a Financial Analyst.

Experience

Intern

OQ – Muscat
June 2023 – August 2023 - Interned at OQ, a leading global energy company shaping Oman’s industrial landscape and operating across 17 countries. - Supported team members in their daily tasks, reducing workload burden and allowing for increased focus on higher-priority assignments. - Gained valuable experience working with SharePoint. - Coordinated with team members to create a web application for the firm. - Developed organizational skills through managing multiple tasks simultaneously while adhering to strict deadlines.

Private Tutor

TutorBright – Winnipeg, MB, Canada
September 2023 – Present - Provided personalized tutoring in economics, mathematics, and computer science to high school and university students. - Simplified complex theories and concepts into digestible explanations, resulting in improved student performance and engagement. - Demonstrated exceptional communication skills to foster confidence and understanding in students.

Developing Finance Model Builder

Self-Initiated Project
Currently in progress - Leveraged programming and analytical skills to start developing a finance model builder aimed at assisting financial analysts in optimizing decision-making processes.

Relevant Coursework

  • Introduction to Statistics and Computing (STAT 1150): Developed a strong foundation in statistical methods, including summarizing and analyzing large datasets, probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, and regression analysis. Gained experience using statistical software to analyze and visualize data.

  • Quantitative Methods in Economics (ECON 2040): Applied statistical techniques to economic data, including descriptive statistics, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, and ordinary least squares regression. Acquired hands-on experience with econometric software for data analysis.

  • Introduction to Econometrics (ECON 3040): Advanced knowledge of econometric methods, including multivariate regression, heteroscedasticity, autocorrelation, and panel data models. Strengthened skills in using matrix algebra and instrumental variables to address complex economic problems.
